Visit note | 2025-07-12 03:00 PM | Dr. Rafiqul Islam, Cardiology | Patient: Champa Faruque, 76, female. Mrs. Faruque presents with chest tightness when walking fast or climbing, alongside breathlessness on effort. She mentions this first felt while rushing to catch a train in Gulshan. She works as a farmer, lives in a rural household, and has no recorded comorbidities. She denies palpitations, dizziness, or nocturnal symptoms. On examination: BP 139/96 mmHg, pulse 85 bpm, weight 70 kg. Heart sounds are dual with no added sounds, and chest is clear. Assessment: Stable angina. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to avoid heavy exertion until review, walk 20 minutes daily on flat ground, and stop smoking. Follow-up in 2 weeks with an ECG and fasting lipid profile.

Visit note | 2025-07-12 03:00 PM | Dr. Zahid Hasan, Gastroenterology | Patient: Nabila Sarkar, 60, female. Mrs. Sarkar returns for review regarding a sour taste in her mouth and symptoms worse when lying down. She notes these issues are worse after weeks of fried snacks at tea stalls in Gazipur. She is a retired civil servant and has a comorbidity of Essential hypertension. She denies dysphagia, vomiting, or significant weight loss. On examination: BMI 27.3, BP 149/88 mmHg, pulse 83 bpm, weight 53 kg. Abdomen is soft and non-tender. Assessment: Gastro-oesophageal reflux disease. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to eat smaller meals, avoid oily and spicy food late at night, and raise the head of the bed. Follow-up in 1 month.

Visit note | 2025-07-12 03:30 PM | Dr. Habibur Rahman, Orthopedics | Patient: Saad Munshi, 26, male. Mr. Munshi comes in reporting a twisted ankle and pain when walking. He explains it was twisted while stepping off a bus in Tejgaon. He works as a call centre agent and has a history of Hypothyroidism. He denies open wounds or previous injuries to this joint. On examination: pain score 7/10, BP 114/76 mmHg, pulse 72 bpm, weight 81 kg. Mild swelling and tenderness are noted over the lateral malleolus, with intact distal neurovascular status. Assessment: Ankle sprain. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised rest, ice, compression, and elevation for 48 hours, and to use a crepe bandage. Follow-up in 1 week.

Visit note | 2025-07-12 04:00 PM | Dr. Kamrul Hasan, Pulmonology | Patient: Jhuma Dey, 53, female. Mrs. Dey describes a cough for one to two weeks after a cold and a sore chest from coughing. She states the trouble began after a family wedding in Badda. She works as an electrician and has Type 2 diabetes mellitus. She denies high fever, night sweats, or hemoptysis. On examination: temperature 98.9°F, BP 114/73 mmHg, pulse 77 bpm, SpO2 98%, weight 57 kg. Laryngotracheal area is tender to touch; chest examination reveals vesicular breath sounds with scattered rhonchi. Assessment: Acute bronchitis. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to drink warm fluids, use steam inhalation twice daily, and avoid smoke. Follow-up in 2 weeks if the cough continues.

Visit note | 2025-07-12 04:30 PM | Dr. Nusrat Jahan, General Medicine | Patient: Liton Molla, 59, male. Mr. Molla presents with looking pale, constant tiredness, and getting breathless on the stairs. He notes this was noticed after months of skipping lunch during long shifts in Bogura. He is a police constable and has no documented comorbidities. He denies chest pain, dizziness, or gastrointestinal bleeding. On examination: haemoglobin 8.8 g/dL, BP 129/81 mmHg, pulse 85 bpm, weight 92 kg. Conjunctivae are pale, and cardiovascular and respiratory examinations are unremarkable. Assessment: Iron deficiency anaemia. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to eat more lentils, spinach, liver, and eggs, and avoid tea within an hour of meals. Follow-up in 6 weeks with a repeat haemoglobin.

Ms. Hossain complains of a rash with spreading edges, a ring-shaped itchy red rash, and itch worse in humid weather. She states it started after playing football on wet fields in Rajshahi. Follow-up in 2 weeks with the symptom diary.
